SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT CSTMR_ID, QUOTA_RE_NO, QUOTA_RE_SEQ, QUOTA_RE_RND FROM KEPCON.KEPMPRQ02 WHERE CSTMR_ID IN ( 'KRHWAS0031C001' , 'KRKRHW0001C001' ) AND SND_CHK = 'N' AND PROCE_STATE_CD IN ('RE04','RE05 ','RE06 ')
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT RQ02.IF_QUOTA_RE_NO AS INQ_NO , RQ02.IF_QUOTA_RE_SEQ AS INQ_SEQ , RQ02.IF_QUOTA_RE_RND AS REVISION , '02' AS INQ_STATUS , RQ03.SLS_UNTPRC AS RECEIVE_PRC , NVL(RQ02.CMS_GDS_NM,' ') AS RETURN_ITEM_NM , NVL(RQ02.CMS_STND_NM,' ') AS RETURN_SPEC , NVL(RQ02.CMS_UNIT_CD,' ') AS RETURN_UNIT , GETMNFATREINFO(CMS_MNFATRE_CD,'MNFATRE_NM') AS RETURN_MAKER , NVL(RQ03.DLVRY_PSSBL_DAYNO, 0) AS DLV_CNT FROM KEPCON.KEPMPRQ02 RQ02, KEPCON.KEPMPRQ04 RQ04, KEPCON.KEPMPRQ03 RQ03 WHERE RQ02.CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_NO$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_SEQ$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_RND = $G_RS.QUOTA_RE_RND$ AND RQ02.PROCE_STATE_CD IN ('RE04','RE05','RE06') AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_NO = RQ04.QUOTA_RE_NO AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_SEQ= RQ04.QUOTA_RE_SEQ AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_RND= RQ04.QUOTA_RE_RND AND RQ03.QUOTA_RQ_NO = RQ04.QUOTA_RQ_NO AND RQ03.QUOTA_RQ_SEQ= RQ04.QUOTA_RQ_SEQ AND RQ03.QUOTA_RQ_RND= RQ04.QUOTA_RQ_RND AND RQ03.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND RQ04.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND RQ03.SUBID_CHK = 'Y'
UPDATE KEPMPRQ02 RQ02 SET SND_CHK = 'Y', SND_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE RQ02.CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_NO$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_SEQ$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_RND = $G_RS.QUOTA_RE_RND$
UPDATE KEPMPRQ02 RQ02 SET SND_CHK = 'E', SND_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE RQ02.CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_NO$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_SEQ$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_RND = $G_RS.QUOTA_RE_RND$
